title: Headless import of project with GDExtensions crashes in `EditorHelp::_gen_extensions_docs`
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.5.stable, 4.6.dev1 and git master at e825169957e4ec67bc0baa6168af02b337399f6f

### System information

Godot v4.5.stable - KDE neon Testing Edition 24.04 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Mobile) - integrated AMD Radeon 780M (RADV PHOENIX) - AMD Ryzen 7 7840U w/ Radeon  780M Graphics (16 threads) - 14.93 GiB memory

### Issue description

Running an import of my project in headless mode always crashes the editor:

```
================================================================
handle_crash: Program crashed with signal 11
Engine version: Godot Engine v4.6.dev.custom_build (e825169957e4ec67bc0baa6168af02b337399f6f)
Dumping the backtrace. Please include this when reporting the bug on: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues
[1] /lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libc.so.6(+0x45330) [0x712a6aa45330] (??:0)
[2] src/godot/bin/godot.linuxbsd.editor.x86_64(+0x22760ab) [0x578086b0e0ab] (src/godot/core/templates/hash_map.h:557)
[3] src/godot/bin/godot.linuxbsd.editor.x86_64(+0x22683cd) [0x578086b003cd] (src/godot/editor/doc/doc_tools.cpp:443 (discriminator 2))
[4] src/godot/bin/godot.linuxbsd.editor.x86_64(+0x22784f9) [0x578086b104f9] (src/godot/editor/doc/editor_help.cpp:3093)

[6] src/godot/bin/godot.linuxbsd.editor.x86_64(+0x57d100b) [0x57808a06900b] (src/godot/core/object/message_queue.cpp:268)
[7] src/godot/bin/godot.linuxbsd.editor.x86_64(+0x7ebc4a) [0x578085083c4a] (src/godot/main/main.cpp:4930)
[8] src/godot/bin/godot.linuxbsd.editor.x86_64(+0x6db278) [0x578084f73278] (src/godot/platform/linuxbsd/godot_linuxbsd.cpp:91)
[9] /lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libc.so.6(+0x2a1ca) [0x712a6aa2a1ca] (??:0)
[10] /lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libc.so.6(__libc_start_main+0x8b) [0x712a6aa2a28b] (??:0)
[11] src/godot/bin/godot.linuxbsd.editor.x86_64(+0x741805) [0x578084fd9805] (??:?)
-- END OF C++ BACKTRACE --
================================================================
```

### Steps to reproduce

To reproduce:

```sh
rm -rf .godot
godot --headless --import
```


### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

This doesn't seem to happen with every project, but I haven't been able to narrow down what is special about ones that do crash. However, this patch resolves the issue for me:

```
diff --git a/editor/doc/editor_help.cpp b/editor/doc/editor_help.cpp
index dd7265f223..c0cbfc04c4 100644
--- a/editor/doc/editor_help.cpp
+++ b/editor/doc/editor_help.cpp
@@ -3087,6 +3087,9 @@ void EditorHelp::_gen_doc_thread(void *p_udata) {
 }
 
 void EditorHelp::_gen_extensions_docs() {
+       if (!doc) {
+               return;
+       }
        doc->generate((DocTools::GENERATE_FLAG_SKIP_BASIC_TYPES | DocTools::GENERATE_FLAG_EXTENSION_CLASSES_ONLY));
 
        // Append extra doc data, as it gets overridden by the generation step.
```
